title: IBM Pipeline Automation for Z: new version generally available
summary: IBM combines Git-based, dependency-aware builds, CLI-based COBOL quality and security scanning, YAML/Ansible/Python-based deployment, COBOL unit tests with coverage, and functional tests via IBM Enterprise Edition for Galasa into one pipeline platform. Positioned as the “outer loop” counterpart to the AI development assistant IBM Bob Premium Package for Z.

title: Zowe 3.6.0 (server release) published
summary: According to the Zowe download page, server release 3.6.0 shipped on 27 Oct 2026; the client components (Zowe Explorer/CLI 3.6) had already arrived in the autumn. In an article on Zowe Explorer 3.6, Broadcom highlights SSH-based connectivity (Zowe Remote SSH) as a faster way to get started.

title: SCLM: IBM updates its Statement of Direction – removal “in a future release”
summary: IBM had originally announced that z/OS 3.2 would be the last release to include SCLM. Following customer feedback, the updated intent is now to remove SCLM from an unspecified future z/OS release. Migration therefore remains necessary, but the time pressure is reduced.

title: DBB 3.0.5.4 maintenance PTF with new optional DB schema
summary: The fix list names PTF UO09871 (DBB 3.0.5.4) for October 2026. According to the documentation, 3.0.5.4 supports schema versions 2.0.2, 3.0.3 and 3.0.5.4; since 3.0.3, schema upgrades are only required for new features.

title: Wazi Deploy 3.0.8: deployment evidence in Db2 and HTML reports
summary: Version 3.0.8 can store the generated deployment evidence directly in Db2 for z/OS, automatically produces an HTML evidence report, extends restart capabilities and adds a new building block cics_prog_update (without CMCI). The fix list most recently shows 3.0.8.3 (October 2026).

title: BMC October release: AMI DevX Unit Test (beta) and Code Pipeline MCP Server (beta)
summary: BMC AMI DevX Unit Test generates test data from COBOL sources and compares runs against an approved baseline in VS Code. The new Code Pipeline MCP Server (beta) connects MCP-capable AI assistants to Code Pipeline build and deploy operations.

extra_links.label: BMC press release: BMC AMI Agentics (20 Oct 2026)

title: IBM Test Accelerator for Z v3.0 with AI-assisted COBOL unit test generation
summary: Version 3.0 generates and runs COBOL unit tests with AI assistance, integrates with VS Code and can be included in CI/CD pipelines (shift-left testing).

title: Endevor 19.0: package approver groups now also via REST API v2, Zowe CLI and Endevor API
summary: The enhancement (PTF LU20326 for V19, LU20331 for V18.1) extends approver group selection to the API and CLI interfaces – relevant for automated approval processes in pipelines.

product: IBM Bob Premium Package for Z
title: IBM Bob Premium Package for Z generally available – successor to watsonx Code Assistant for Z
summary: IBM positions the package as an agentic AI development partner for IBM Z with modes, reusable “skills”, repository-level AGENTS.md rules and impact analysis based on Z Understand.

title: Endevor Bridge for Git 2.x: end of service on 30 June 2027
summary: Broadcom ends support for Bridge for Git 2.x and earlier on 30 June 2027. Users are advised to move to 3.0 or later (prerequisites include Java 17 and higher hardware requirements).

title: Team Build 1.11.0: simplified export for Bridge for Git workflows and SBOM improvements
summary: New features include the --build-scripts-only flag (exportz) for change-based builds in a Bridge for Git context, wildcard mappings in sbomz and space checks in syncz.

title: Endevor Bridge for Git 3.2.1 generally available
summary: Improved branch merging, configurable limits for hook notifications with large mappings and additional security hardening. Also delivered as a Docker image and Helm chart.

title: Zowe 3.5.0 published
summary: Another release of the V3 LTS line (SMP/E PTFs, PSWI and convenience build on zowe.org).

title: DBB 3.0.5 release PTF
summary: Release PTF UO07766 (May 2026). Since DBB 3.0.4.1, zBuilder generates build maps by default – this requires a DB fix script.

title: Zowe 3.4 LTS: Bridge for Git plug-in V3-conformant, multiple OIDC providers
summary: The release includes V3 conformance of the Endevor Bridge for Git plug-in for Zowe CLI, support for multiple OIDC providers at the same time and ICSF keyrings in the API Mediation Layer.

title: Galasa 0.45.0: cleanup of local test runs, timeouts for waiting runs
summary: The open-source integration test framework for z/OS adds, among other things, the command galasactl runs cleanup local; 0.44.0 (October 2025) updated the Kubernetes client and Helm options.

title: Rocket Software announces a new DevOps generation for IBM Z and IBM i
summary: Focus areas according to the press release: Git-integrated source change management, CI/CD and LLM API integration, AI-assisted code explanation (e.g. COBOL), anomaly detection, and compliance through separation of duties and audit reports.

title: Endevor Bridge for Git 3.0 generally available
summary: Major release with multi-branching, separate sync and refresh operations, a new front end and a new TechDocs site. Java 17 is a prerequisite; note the breaking changes.

title: BMC Mainframe Survey 2025: 67% use DevOps on the mainframe
summary: The 20th edition (more than 1,100 respondents) reports DevOps adoption of 67% (previous year: 63%); 26% saw benefits in under six months. Millennials make up 51% and Gen Z 15% of respondents. Note: vendor survey.

title: Zowe 3.3 LTS: API ML as a single service (tech preview), JCL-based installation
summary: New features include the API Mediation Layer as a single JVM process (technical preview), zwe init via JCL including dry run, a table view for data sets and job polling in Zowe Explorer.

title: GitLab Ultimate for IBM Z with native z/OS runner
summary: GitLab and IBM offer a joint solution with a GitLab Runner running natively on z/OS and integration with IBM Developer for z/OS Enterprise Edition (including dependency-based builds).

title: BMC describes the Git integration of AMI DevX Code Pipeline (formerly ISPW)
summary: Git for source control, Code Pipeline for build and deployment on z/OS; integrations for Jenkins, GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. According to BMC, Code Pipeline also supports “100% Git” operation.

title: DBB 3.0.2: Java 21, JCL-to-YAML migration tool, z/OS Connect task
summary: zBuilder approaches parity with zAppBuild: integrated build maps, “scan only” for initial population of metadata, automatic migration of zAppBuild metadata and a tool that generates YAML language configurations from build JCL.

title: ChangeMan ZMF now belongs to Rocket Software
summary: OpenText sold its AMC business (formerly Micro Focus, including ChangeMan ZMF) to Rocket Software for USD 2.275 billion. The product is now called Rocket ChangeMan ZMF.

title: IBM Expert Labs success story: Endevor to GitLab at dwpbank with Q Group’s Q-Wing
summary: Success story on the migration of 181,435 Endevor elements to GitLab with z/OS runners, IBM DBB and Wazi Deploy, delivered by IBM Expert Labs and Q Group in 11 months. Q-Wing migrated application bundles automatically and archived older versions to DMS3. A companion story covers Atruvia (about 3.6 million elements, Bitbucket/Jenkins/DBB/UCD). As reported in the IBM Expert Labs success story, available via the Q Group website; figures not independently verified.

product: IDz Enterprise Edition 18.0 / ADFz 6.0 (DBB 4.0, Wazi Deploy 4.0)
title: IBM Developer for z/OS EE 18.0 and ADFz 6.0: DBB 4.0, Wazi Deploy 4.0 and the new Release Orchestrator for Z
summary: The major release adds IBM Release Orchestrator for Z (part of Wazi Deploy) to schedule and coordinate deployments across multiple applications, release groups, targets and phases via a web interface. DBB 4.0.0 brings cross-application dependency support in zBuilder (versioned build packages published and imported across Git repositories, impact analysis on imported dependencies), Java 25 support and a new 'dbb validate' command; from 4.0.0, DBB is only available as a component of other offerings. Wazi Deploy adds GitLab package registry support and MCP tools; ZCodeScan adds new COBOL and PL/I rules and baselines.

title: Endevor and AI: read-only MCP bridge to the Endevor inventory in beta
summary: Broadcom announced beta availability of a read-only bridge that connects an LLM of the customer's choice to the Endevor inventory via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Access to the beta is by request through the Broadcom community post.

title: Rocket Transaction Platform: replatforming option added to Rocket’s modernization portfolio
summary: Rocket announced a platform to replatform and continuously modernize COBOL, PL/I, Java and Python transaction applications on distributed and cloud environments, including AI-assisted code understanding, documentation and unit test generation. Rocket positions it next to its agentic AI platform Rocket EVA for customers who modernize on the mainframe. Not a z/OS CI/CD tool itself, but relevant context for “modernize on platform vs. replatform” decisions.

title: Zowe V2 reaches end of support on 30 March 2027 – remaining V2 maintenance releases scheduled
summary: According to the Open Mainframe Project, Zowe V2 reaches end of support on 30 March 2027; a Broadcom session at GS UK Forge 2026 covered migrating the API Mediation Layer from V2 to V3. The Zowe release schedule lists V2 maintenance releases 2.18.7 (GA 24 Nov 2026) and 2.18.8 (GA 30 Mar 2027); the next V3 release, 3.7.0, is planned for 2 Mar 2027.

title: Git for z/OS: encoding-aware 3-way merges and opt-in transliteration in the zopen community port
summary: According to an IBM Community blog post by a zopen community maintainer, the latest Git port for z/OS handles EBCDIC-encoded files natively in git apply --3way, and applies encoding conversion and file tagging consistently in merges, cherry-picks, rebases and stashes. A new opt-in setting (core.iconvtranslit) substitutes the closest character (e.g. “€” → “EUR”) instead of stopping when a character has no EBCDIC equivalent; strict conversion stays the default. The zopen release overview lists Git 2.56.1 builds from 11–12 Nov 2026.

title: Zowe makes security-driven breaking changes in minor and maintenance releases – including V2 2.18.7
summary: The Zowe documentation (updated 6 Nov 2026) states that, in response to a growing number of security reports produced with the help of frontier AI models, the project now makes breaking changes outside major releases where a security fix requires it. Affected releases listed: Zowe client 3.6.0, Zowe server 3.6.0, Zowe client 3.7.0 and Zowe 2.18.7 (GA planned for 24 Nov 2026). Opt-out flags exist where possible, but the project recommends adapting rather than opting out. Pipelines that call the Zowe CLI should be re-tested before upgrading.

title: DBB Git Migration Modeler 2.0.0: rewritten in Java, zBuilder only, incremental additions to existing repositories
summary: Major version of IBM’s open-source tool for modeling application boundaries and migrating z/OS sources to Git. According to the release notes, the Groovy scripts were converted to Java, support for zAppBuild was dropped in favor of the DBB zBuilder, the Git repository structure was simplified, sources can be added incrementally to previously initialized repositories, and the DBB MetadataStore can be initialized with the zBuilder metadata lifecycle.

product: IBM Bob Premium Package for Z
title: IBM Bob Premium Package for Z adds a self-hosted (on-premises) deployment option
summary: IBM announced a self-hosted deployment option in which Bob services run in a customer-managed Red Hat OpenShift environment, with approved models hosted internally or externally through the Bob model gateway. New capabilities named in the announcement: Application View (top-down application understanding in the IDE), zContext (IBM-curated Z-specific knowledge supplied to the assistant) and COBOL performance recommendations that use application runtime profiling data.

title: IBM Z Atlas: system intelligence and change orchestration for z/OS enters public preview
summary: Announced at IBM TechXchange 2026, IBM Z Atlas is intended as a system-intelligence and change-orchestration layer across the z/OS stack: automated discovery and a topology of infrastructure, middleware, applications and operational processes, dependency and impact analysis, AI-assisted test planning and change evidence for audits. In an interview, IBM’s VP of IBM Z Hybrid Cloud stated that the public preview opened on 27 Oct 2026, general availability is targeted for Q1 2027, z/OS 3.1 is required, and the customer’s existing deployment and change-management systems continue to govern production execution. For CI/CD this is a source of impact analysis and evidence, not a replacement for build or deployment tooling; the efficiency figures in the announcement come from IBM’s early design program.

extra_links.label: Interview with IBM (Coder Legion, 27 Oct 2026): availability and requirements

title: Zowe CLI 8.44.0: REST responses above 64 MiB now fail by default (breaking change)
summary: Zowe CLI v8.44.0 (released on GitHub on 24 Nov 2026) bounds the memory used by REST responses: buffered responses that accumulate more than 64 MiB, or decompress to more than 64 MiB, now fail with an error; streamed downloads are limited to 8 GiB after decompression. The commands zos-files view data-set, zos-files view uss-file, zos-jobs view spool-file-by-id and zos-jobs view all-spool-content get a new --max-response-bytes option; the error message suggests downloading large content to a file instead. Pipeline steps that print large data sets or job spool via the CLI should be re-tested. On npm, 8.44.0 is published under the “latest” tag; the “zowe-v3-lts” tag still pointed to 8.43.0 when checked on 25 Nov 2026.
